findings.current: Nearly seven days and nights had passed since the horrific day of the Three-Sect Bloodbath.
findings.defect: “Nearly seven” changes the stated elapsed time to less than seven days; the source says seven days and nights had already passed.
findings.rationale: 어언 marks the realization that the full period has already elapsed, while 칠 주야 specifies exactly seven days and nights.
findings.replacement: Seven days and nights had already passed since the horrific day of the Three-Sect Bloodbath.
findings.source: 참혹했던 삼문혈사의 그날로부터 어언 칠 주야.

findings.current: His older cousin, on the other hand, was an extraordinary figure not only in age but also in his standing within Murim.
findings.defect: “Extraordinary in age” is unnatural and misstates the comparison; the source says his cousin was considerably older as well as eminent in Murim.
findings.rationale: 연배 refers to age or seniority, not to the cousin’s age being extraordinary.
findings.replacement: His older cousin, on the other hand, was considerably older and held an eminent position in Murim.
findings.source: 반면 그의 종형은 연배는 물론이거니와 무림에서의 입지도 대단한 인물이었다.

findings.current: It was because it was the Tang Clan. Even if you took away the ‘Sichuan’ from its name, that fact would not change.
findings.defect: The translation omits 오직, weakening the exclusive causal claim that forms the core of Jin Wikyung’s argument for relocation.
findings.rationale: 오직 means “solely” or “only”; Jin Wikyung is asserting that the clan endured because of its identity as the Tang Clan, not because of its location.
findings.replacement: It was solely because it was the Tang Clan. Even if you took away the ‘Sichuan’ from its name, that fact would not change.
findings.source: 오직 당문(唐門)이었기 때문입니다. 앞의 두 글자를 떼어 낸다 한들 그 사실은 변하지 않습니다.

findings.defect: The spoken reaction 저런 is omitted and replaced with silence, removing Jin Wikyung’s mild expression of dismay.
findings.rationale: 저런 is an audible, restrained reaction to Samgoe’s condition, not an unspoken pause.

summary: Four actionable findings: one altered time quantity, one distorted age comparison, one weakened causal emphasis, and one omitted reaction.
